Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

Theorem pos_esa_sound: forall im cm evs E A B,
  Sub im cm evs E A B ->
  sub_amber2 (map drop_im E) A B.

Theorem pos_esa_complete_final: forall A B,
    sub_amber2 nil A B ->
    exists cm evs, Sub Pos cm evs nil A B.

10	| typ_mu :    typ -> typ

19	  match T with
20	  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
21	  | typ_top         => typ_top
22	  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
23	  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
24	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)

36	      type (typ_fvar X)
37	  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
38	      type T1 ->
39	      type T2 ->
40	      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)

47	  match T with
48	  | typ_top => typ_top
49	  | typ_nat => typ_nat
50	  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
51	  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
52	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
53	  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
54	  end.

56	Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
57	  match T with
58	  | typ_top => {}
59	  | typ_nat => {}
60	  | typ_bvar J => {}
61	  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
62	  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)

64	  end.

67	
68	Inductive CmpMode := Lt | Eq.
69

71	  | bind_sub : IsoMode -> binding
72	  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

83	| WFS_fvar : forall X E im,
84	    binds X (bind_sub im) E ->

87	    WFS E A ->

91	
92	
93	      (forall  X , X \notin L ->

95	      WFS E (typ_mu A).

104	  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
105	      wf_env E ->
106	      WFS E T ->
107	      x `notin` dom E ->
108	      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).
109	
110	Definition flip_im (im : IsoMode) : IsoMode :=
111	  match im with
112	    | Neg => Pos
113	    | Pos => Neg
114	  end.
115	
116	Definition compose_cm (cm1 cm2 : CmpMode) (evs1 evs2 : atoms ) : option (CmpMode) :=
117	  match cm1, cm2 with
118	    | Lt, Lt => Some Lt
119	    | Eq, Lt => if AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1 then Some Lt else None
120	    | Lt, Eq => if AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs2 then Some Lt else None
121	    | Eq, Eq => Some Eq
122	  end.

125	  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
126	  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
127	  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
128	  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
129	  | exp_nat : exp
130	  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
131	  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
132	.

135	
136	Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.
137	
138	Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
139	  match e with
140	  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
141	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
142	  | exp_abs t e1 => exp_abs t (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
143	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
144	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
145	  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (open_ee_rec k f e)

152	  match e with
153	  | (exp_bvar n)   => exp_bvar n
154	  | (exp_fvar x)   => (if x == y then u else (exp_fvar x))
155	  | (exp_abs T e1)    => exp_abs T (subst_ee y u e1)
156	  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_ee y u e1) (subst_ee y u e2)
157	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
158	  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (subst_ee y u e)
159	  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (subst_ee y u e)
160	  end.
161	
162	Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
163	  match e_5 with
164	  | (exp_bvar nat)   => {}
165	  | (exp_fvar x)   => {{x}}
166	  | (exp_abs T e)     => fv_exp e
167	  | (exp_app e1 e2) => fv_exp e1 \u fv_exp e2
168	  | exp_nat => {}
169	  | exp_unfold T e => fv_exp e
170	  | exp_fold T e => fv_exp e
171	  end.
172	
173	Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
174	 | lc_fvar : forall (x:var),
175	     expr (exp_fvar x)
176	 | lc_abs : forall (e:exp) L T,
177	     (forall x, x \notin L -> expr (open_ee e (exp_fvar x)))  ->

181	     expr e1 ->
182	     expr e2 ->
183	     expr (exp_app e1 e2)
184	 | lc_nat :
185	     expr exp_nat
186	 | lc_unfold: forall T e,
187	     type T ->
188	     expr e ->
189	     expr (exp_unfold T e)
190	 | lc_fold: forall T e,
191	     type T ->
192	     expr e ->
193	     expr (exp_fold T e).

196	
197	
198	
199	
200

212	
213	
214

216	
217	
218	| Sa_top_lt: forall E im A,

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Inductive typ : Set :=
| typ_top   : typ
| typ_nat   : typ
| typ_bvar  : nat -> typ
| typ_fvar  : var -> typ
| typ_mu :    typ -> typ
| typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
.

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  end.

Inductive IsoMode := Neg | Pos.

Inductive CmpMode := Lt | Eq.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : IsoMode -> binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Definition emp := Metatheory.empty.

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E im,
    binds X (bind_sub im) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A im,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub im ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) im,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub im ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Definition flip_im (im : IsoMode) : IsoMode :=
  match im with
    | Neg => Pos
    | Pos => Neg
  end.

Definition compose_cm (cm1 cm2 : CmpMode) (evs1 evs2 : atoms ) : option (CmpMode) :=
  match cm1, cm2 with
    | Lt, Lt => Some Lt
    | Eq, Lt => if AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1 then Some Lt else None
    | Lt, Eq => if AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs2 then Some Lt else None
    | Eq, Eq => Some Eq
  end.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs t e1 => exp_abs t (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (open_ee_rec k f e)
  end.

Notation open_ee e1 e2     := (open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1).

Fixpoint subst_ee (y:atom) (u:exp) (e:exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | (exp_bvar n)   => exp_bvar n
  | (exp_fvar x)   => (if x == y then u else (exp_fvar x))
  | (exp_abs T e1)    => exp_abs T (subst_ee y u e1)
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => exp_app (subst_ee y u e1) (subst_ee y u e2)
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_unfold T e => exp_unfold T (subst_ee y u e)
  | exp_fold T e => exp_fold T (subst_ee y u e)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (exp_bvar nat)   => {}
  | (exp_fvar x)   => {{x}}
  | (exp_abs T e)     => fv_exp e
  | (exp_app e1 e2) => fv_exp e1 \u fv_exp e2
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_unfold T e => fv_exp e
  | exp_fold T e => fv_exp e
  end.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_fvar : forall (x:var),
     expr (exp_fvar x)
 | lc_abs : forall (e:exp) L T,
     (forall x, x \notin L -> expr (open_ee e (exp_fvar x)))  ->
     type T ->
     expr (exp_abs T e)
 | lc_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_app e1 e2)
 | lc_nat :
     expr exp_nat
 | lc_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
 | lc_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e).

Inductive Sub : IsoMode -> CmpMode -> atoms -> env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=





| Sa_nat: forall E im,
    wf_env E ->
    Sub im Eq emp E typ_nat typ_nat





| Sa_top_eq: forall E im,
    wf_env E ->
    Sub im Eq emp E typ_top typ_top






| Sa_top_lt: forall E im A,
    wf_env E -> WFS E A -> A <> typ_top ->
    Sub im Lt emp E A typ_top
| Sa_fvar_pos: forall E X im,
    wf_env E -> binds X (bind_sub im) E ->
    Sub im Eq emp E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| Sa_fvar_neg: forall E X im,
    wf_env E -> binds X (bind_sub (flip_im im)) E ->
    Sub im Eq (singleton X) E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| Sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im,
    Sub (flip_im im) cm1 evs1 E B1 A1 ->
    Sub im cm2 evs2 E A2 B2 ->
    compose_cm cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 = Some cm ->
    Sub im cm (evs1 `union` evs2) E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| Sa_rec_lt: forall L A1 A2 evs E im,
    (forall X,  X \notin L ->
        Sub im Lt evs (X ~ bind_sub im ++ E) (open_tt A1 X) (open_tt A2 X)) ->

    Sub im Lt evs E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| Sa_rec_eq_notin: forall L A1 A2 evs E im,
    (forall X,  X \notin L ->
        Sub im Eq evs (X ~ bind_sub im ++ E) (open_tt A1 X) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    Sub im Eq evs E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)





| Sa_rec_eq_in: forall L A1 A2 evs E im,
    (forall X,  X \notin L ->
        Sub im Eq (add X evs) (X ~ bind_sub im ++ E) (open_tt A1 X) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    Sub im Eq (evs `union` fv_tt A1) E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| Sa_evs_proper: forall im cm evs evs' E A1 A2,
    Sub im cm evs E A1 A2 ->
    evs [=] evs' ->
    Sub im cm evs' E A1 A2
.

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
| typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
| typing_var : forall (G:env) (x:var) (T:typ),
     wf_env G ->
     binds x (bind_typ T) G  ->
     typing G (exp_fvar x) T
 | typing_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (T1:typ) (e:exp) (T2:typ),
     (forall x , x \notin L -> typing ((x ~ bind_typ T1) ++ G) (open_ee e x) T2)  ->
     typing G (exp_abs T1 e) (typ_arrow T1 T2)
 | typing_app : forall (G:env) (e1 e2:exp) (T2 T1:typ),
     typing G e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
     typing G e2 T1 ->
     typing G (exp_app e1 e2) T2
 | typing_fold : forall G A e ,
     typing G e  (open_tt A  (typ_mu A))    ->
     WFS G (typ_mu A) ->
     typing G (exp_fold (typ_mu A) e) (typ_mu A)
 | typing_unfold : forall G T e,
     typing G e (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold (typ_mu T) e)  (open_tt T  (typ_mu T))
 | typing_sub: forall G T e S evs cm,
     typing G e S ->
     Sub Pos cm evs G S T ->

     typing G e T.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
 | step_fld: forall S T v,
     value v ->
     type T ->
     type S ->
     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e').

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export PosVar.

Definition mode_xor (m1 m2 : IsoMode) : IsoMode :=
  match m1 with
  | Pos => match m2 with
           | Pos => Pos
           | Neg => Neg
           end
  | Neg => match m2 with
           | Pos => Neg
           | Neg => Pos
           end
  end.

Definition mode_choose {A:Type} im im_x (C D:A) :=
  match im, im_x with
  | Pos, Pos => C
  | Pos, Neg => D
  | Neg, Pos => D
  | Neg, Neg => C
  end.

Definition well_bind_env im (E:env) (A B : typ) :=
  (forall X im_x,
    (binds X (bind_sub im_x) E -> posvar (mode_xor im im_x) X A B)).

Inductive typePairR : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| tp_nat:
    typePairR  typ_nat typ_nat
| tp_top: forall  A ,
    type A ->
    typePairR  A typ_top
| tp_top_flip: forall A ,
    type A ->
    typePairR  typ_top A
| tp_fvar_x: forall X,
    typePairR (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| tp_arrow: forall  A1 A2 B1 B2,
    typePairR  B1 A1 ->
    typePairR  A2 B2 ->
    typePairR  (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| tp_rec: forall  A B L,
    (forall X, X \notin L ->
               typePairR (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    typePairR (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B).

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).

  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos

Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).

  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.

Proof.

  - split; apply type_top.

  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.

  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);

  - (* nat / nat *) reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; destruct (K === n0) eqn:E2;
      simpl in Heq; try discriminate.

    + reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / fvar a *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto.
    (* HA : X \notin fv (bvar n) trivial, HB : X \notin {{X}} *)
    apply HB.
  - (* fvar a / fvar b *)
    injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
  - (* fvar a / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto. apply HA.
  - (* arrow / arrow *)
    injection Heq as H1 H2.
    f_equal.
    + eapply IHA1; eauto.
    + eapply IHA2; eauto.
  - (* mu / mu *)
    injection Heq as H1.
    f_equal. eapply IHA; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_inj : forall X A B,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

Theorem pos_esa_sound: forall im cm evs E A B,
  Sub im cm evs E A B ->
  sub_amber2 (map drop_im E) A B.

Theorem pos_esa_complete_final: forall A B,
    sub_amber2 nil A B ->
    exists cm evs, Sub Pos cm evs nil A B.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. apply epos_env_cons. Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. apply binds_drop_im. auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (H X HX). specialize (IHH X HX).
    rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHH. exact IHH.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - apply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (H X HX). specialize (IHH X HX).
    rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHH. exact IHH.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H. induction H.
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IHSub1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IHSub2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A. revert K X. induction A; intros K X B HA HB Heq;
    destruct B; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - (* top / top *) reflexivity.
  - (* nat / nat *) reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; destruct (K === n0) eqn:E2;
      simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    + injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / fvar a *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto.
    (* HA : X \notin fv (bvar n) trivial, HB : X \notin {{X}} *)
    apply HB.
  - (* fvar a / fvar b *)
    injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
  - (* fvar a / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto. apply HA.
  - (* arrow / arrow *)
    injection Heq as H1 H2.
    f_equal.
    + eapply IHA1; eauto.
    + eapply IHA2; eauto.
  - (* mu / mu *)
    injection Heq as H1.
    f_equal. eapply IHA; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_inj : forall X A B,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Proof.

Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.

    specialize (H X HX). specialize (IHH X HX).
    rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHH. exact IHH.

  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (H X HX). specialize (IHH X HX).
    rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHH. exact IHH.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.

    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.

Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H. induction H.
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IHSub1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IHSub2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A. revert K X. induction A; intros K X B HA HB Heq;
    destruct B; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - (* top / top *) reflexivity.
  - (* nat / nat *) reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; destruct (K === n0) eqn:E2;
      simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    + injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / fvar a *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto.
    (* HA : X \notin fv (bvar n) trivial, HB : X \notin {{X}} *)
    apply HB.
  - (* fvar a / fvar b *)
    injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
  - (* fvar a / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto. apply HA.
  - (* arrow / arrow *)
    injection Heq as H1 H2.
    f_equal.
    + eapply IHA1; eauto.
    + eapply IHA2; eauto.
  - (* mu / mu *)
    injection Heq as H1.
    f_equal. eapply IHA; eauto.
Qed.

  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos

  end.

Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Qed.

  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := im). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H. induction H.
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IHSub1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IHSub2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A. revert K X. induction A; intros K X B HA HB Heq;
    destruct B; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - (* top / top *) reflexivity.
  - (* nat / nat *) reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; destruct (K === n0) eqn:E2;
      simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    + injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / fvar a *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto.
    (* HA : X \notin fv (bvar n) trivial, HB : X \notin {{X}} *)
    apply HB.
  - (* fvar a / fvar b *)
    injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
  - (* fvar a / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto. apply HA.
  - (* arrow / arrow *)
    injection Heq as H1 H2.
    f_equal.
    + eapply IHA1; eauto.
    + eapply IHA2; eauto.
  - (* mu / mu *)
    injection Heq as H1.
    f_equal. eapply IHA; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_inj : forall X A B,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.

Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H. induction H.
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IHSub1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IHSub2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L);
      intros X HX; [ apply IHSub1 | apply IHSub2 ]; auto.
  - auto.
Qed.

  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A. revert K X. induction A; intros K X B HA HB Heq;
    destruct B; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - (* top / top *) reflexivity.
  - (* nat / nat *) reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; destruct (K === n0) eqn:E2;
      simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    + injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* bvar n / fvar a *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto.
    (* HA : X \notin fv (bvar n) trivial, HB : X \notin {{X}} *)
    apply HB.
  - (* fvar a / fvar b *)
    injection Heq as ->. reflexivity.
  - (* fvar a / bvar n *)
    destruct (K === n) eqn:E1; simpl in Heq; try discriminate.
    injection Heq as HX. subst a.
    exfalso. apply (notin_singleton_1 X X). auto. apply HA.
  - (* arrow / arrow *)
    injection Heq as H1 H2.
    f_equal.

    + eapply IHA2; eauto.
  - (* mu / mu *)
    injection Heq as H1.
    f_equal. eapply IHA; eauto.
Qed.

  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

    (forall X , X \notin L ->

    (forall X , X \notin L ->

    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.

  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].

  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.

  | bind_sub : binding

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->

    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)

      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

  | wf_env_empty :

  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,

      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)

  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top

    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)

      WFS E (typ_mu A).

  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2

  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.

  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.

  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.

    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.

  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].

  - split; apply type_top.

  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 T2 IH1 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_inj : forall X A B,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
