Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),

Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.

  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.

  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.

  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.

    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Proof.

  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.

  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Proof.

  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_inj : forall X A B,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. auto.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto. simpl in HA. eapply notin_union_1; eauto.
    + apply IH2; auto. simpl in HA. eapply notin_union_2; eauto.
  - simpl. apply IH1; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. auto.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto. simpl in HA. eapply notin_union_1; eauto.
    + apply IH2; auto. simpl in HA. eapply notin_union_2; eauto.
  - simpl. apply IH1; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).

      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }

    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.

      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. exact HY.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl in HA.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. apply IH1; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).
    { intros Y HY. apply (notin_singleton_1 X Y).
      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.
      * exact HY.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. exact HY.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

Lemma open_tt_inj : forall X A B,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

```
Lemma Sub_eq_implies_eq : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> cm = Eq -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H. revert cm. (* hmm *)
  induction H; intros Hcm; try discriminate; auto.
```
Better: `intros im cm evs E A B H. induction H; intros Hcm; try discriminate; auto.` but induction needs the goal `cm = Eq -> A = B` with cm an index; Coq may complain about the dependent index cm when inducting. We'll use `intros ... H. revert Hcm` approach: state as `forall ..., Sub ... -> cm = Eq -> A = B` and do `intros ... H; induction H; intros Hcm; ...`. The induction motive includes cm? Since H : Sub im cm evs E A B and we have Hcm introduced after induction, the goal after induction is `cm = Eq -> A = B` with cm being the constructor's cm value (fixed), so fine. The IH for premises will be functions over their cm? The induction principle for Sub: since Sub's indices include cm and the motive is over all indices (E,A,B,im,cm,evs?), `induction H` generalizes the goal over the indices. The goal is `cm = Eq -> A = B` which mentions cm and A,B; Coq should abstract them. Let's try.

Actually, a cleaner statement avoiding cm index issues: `forall im cm evs E A B, Sub im cm evs E A B -> cm = Eq -> A = B`. Use `intros im cm evs E A B H; induction H; intros Hcm; try discriminate; auto.` Then case bullets. Let's test.

For arrow: goal A1? The conclusion types are (arrow A1 A2)(arrow B1 B2). IH1 : cm1 = Eq -> B1 = A1; IH2 : cm2 = Eq -> A2 = B2. Hcm : cm = Eq where cm comes from compose_cm. We need A1=B1 and A2=B2 then f_equal. But Hcm : compose_cm ... = Some Eq doesn't directly give cm1=Eq and cm2=Eq. Hmm! The arrow rule's cm is the compose result; to conclude arrow A1 A2 = arrow B1 B2 we need B1=A1 and A2=B2. From compose_cm cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 = Some Eq, what can we deduce? compose_cm returns Some Eq only in the Eq,Eq case? Let's check: match cm1,cm2 with Lt,Lt=>Lt; Eq,Lt=> if ... then Lt else None; Lt,Eq=> then Lt else None; Eq,Eq=>Eq. So Some Eq implies cm1=Eq and cm2=Eq! Great. Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.

  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].

  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.

  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.

  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf

  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].

  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;

  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;

  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)

  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. apply IH1; auto.
  - simpl in HA.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).
    { intros Y HY. apply (notin_singleton_1 X Y).
      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.
