Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. apply IH1; auto.
  - simpl in HA.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];

  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).
    { intros Y HY. apply (notin_singleton_1 X Y).
      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }

    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.
      * exact HY.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. exact HY.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

Lemma compose_cm_Eq : forall cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2,
  compose_cm cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 = Some Eq -> cm1 = Eq /\ cm2 = Eq.
Proof.
  intros cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 H. destruct cm1, cm2; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs2); discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1); discriminate.
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma Sub_eq_implies_eq : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> cm = Eq -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ];
    intros Hcm; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hcm in Hcomp. apply compose_cm_Eq in Hcomp. destruct Hcomp as [E1 E2].
    f_equal.
    + symmetry. apply IH1. exact E1.
    + apply IH2. exact E2.
  - (* rec_eq_notin *)
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A1 \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXa : X \notin L \u fv_tt A1) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; exact HX).
    assert (HXb : X \notin fv_tt A2) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; exact HX).
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HXa; exact HXa).
    assert (HX1 : X \notin fv_tt A1) by (apply notin_union_2 in HXa; exact HXa).
    assert (Hop : open_tt A1 X = open_tt A2 X) by (apply IHf; auto).
    f_equal. eapply open_tt_inj; eauto.
  - (* rec_eq_in *)
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u fv_tt A1 \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    assert (HXa : X \notin L \u fv_tt A1) by (apply notin_union_1 in HX; exact HX).
    assert (HXb : X \notin fv_tt A2) by (apply notin_union_2 in HX; exact HX).
    assert (HXL : X \notin L) by (apply notin_union_1 in HXa; exact HXa).
    assert (HX1 : X \notin fv_tt A1) by (apply notin_union_2 in HXa; exact HXa).
    assert (Hop : open_tt A1 X = open_tt A2 X) by (apply IHf; auto).
    f_equal. eapply open_tt_inj; eauto.
  - auto.
Qed.

  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

Lemma compose_cm_Eq : forall cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2,
  compose_cm cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 = Some Eq -> cm1 = Eq /\ cm2 = Eq.
Proof.
  intros cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 H. destruct cm1, cm2; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs2); discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1); discriminate.
  - auto.
Qed.

    | E im Hwf

    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ];
    intros Hcm; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hcm in Hcomp. apply compose_cm_Eq in Hcomp. destruct Hcomp as [E1 E2].
    f_equal.
    + symmetry. apply IH1. exact E1.

  - (* rec_eq_notin *)
    destruct (atom_fresh ((L \u fv_tt A1) \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. apply IH1; auto.
  - simpl in HA.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).
    { intros Y HY. apply (notin_singleton_1 X Y).
      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.
      * exact HY.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. exact HY.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. apply IH1; auto.
  - simpl in HA.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).
    { intros Y HY. apply (notin_singleton_1 X Y).
      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.
      * exact HY.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. exact HY.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* The soundness invariant                                      *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1); discriminate.
  - auto.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - split; apply type_var.
  - destruct IH1 as [HB1 HA1]. destruct IH2 as [HA2 HB2].
    split; apply type_arrow; auto.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - auto.
Qed.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. apply IH1; auto.
  - simpl in HA.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).
    { intros Y HY. apply (notin_singleton_1 X Y).
      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.
      * exact HY.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. exact HY.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

Lemma compose_cm_Eq : forall cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2,
  compose_cm cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 = Some Eq -> cm1 = Eq /\ cm2 = Eq.
Proof.
  intros cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 H. destruct cm1, cm2; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs2); discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1); discriminate.
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma Sub_eq_implies_eq : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> cm = Eq -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ];
    intros Hcm; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hcm in Hcomp. apply compose_cm_Eq in Hcomp. destruct Hcomp as [E1 E2].
    f_equal.
    + symmetry. apply IH1. exact E1.
    + apply IH2. exact E2.
  - (* rec_eq_notin *)
    destruct (atom_fresh ((L \u fv_tt A1) \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXa.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXb.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HXL.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HX1.
    assert (Hop : open_tt A1 X = open_tt A2 X) by (apply IHf; auto).
    f_equal. eapply open_tt_inj; eauto.
  - (* rec_eq_in *)
    destruct (atom_fresh ((L \u fv_tt A1) \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXa.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXb.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HXL.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HX1.
    assert (Hop : open_tt A1 X = open_tt A2 X) by (apply IHf; auto).
    f_equal. eapply open_tt_inj; eauto.
  - auto.
Qed.

  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.

| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat

    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->

  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty

      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)

    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)

    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->

(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.

  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.

  - apply WFS_nat.

  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.

    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.

    | E X im Hwf Hb

    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].

  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.

  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.
  - split; apply type_mu with (L := L); intros X HX;
      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.

  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.

  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.

(* Positivity facts                                             *)

  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.

    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.

    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.

    + apply IH2; auto.

Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

    | X A m Hty

    | X Y m HXY

    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2

  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.

    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.

    + apply IH2; auto.

    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.

      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.

  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.

(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)

Proof.
  intros cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 H. destruct cm1, cm2; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs2); discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1); discriminate.
  - auto.
Qed.

  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.

  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf

    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].

  - split; apply type_top.
  - split. apply Rules_WFS_type with (E := E); auto. apply type_top.

      destruct (IHf X HX) as [T1 T2]; assumption.

(* Closing a fresh free variable back into a bound variable. *)
Fixpoint close_tt_rec (K : nat) (Z : atom) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then typ_bvar K else typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (close_tt_rec K Z T1) (close_tt_rec K Z T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (close_tt_rec (S K) Z T)
  end.

Lemma close_open_tt : forall K Z T,
  Z \notin fv_tt T ->
  close_tt_rec K Z (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Z) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros K Z T. revert K.
  induction T as [ | | n | a | T1 IH1 | T1 IH1 T2 IH2 ]; intros K HZ.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + subst. destruct (Z == Z) as [E2|E2]; [ reflexivity | exfalso; apply E2; reflexivity ].
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. destruct (a == Z) as [E|E]; simpl.
    + exfalso. apply HZ. subst a. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - simpl. f_equal. apply IH1. simpl in HZ. exact HZ.
  - simpl in HZ.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 Z (fv_tt T1) (fv_tt T2) HZ) as HZ2.
    simpl. rewrite (IH1 K HZ1). rewrite (IH2 K HZ2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Injectivity of opening at a fresh variable. *)
Lemma open_tt_rec_inj : forall K X A,
  X \notin fv_tt A ->
  forall B, X \notin fv_tt B ->
    open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) A = open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar X) B -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros K X A HA B HB Heq.
  assert (H := f_equal (close_tt_rec K X) Heq).
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X A HA) in H.
  rewrite (close_open_tt K X B HB) in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Positivity facts                                             *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma fv_open_tt_rec : forall X Y K A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt_rec K (typ_fvar Y) A).
Proof.
  intros X Y K A. revert K.
  induction A as [ | | n | a | A1 IH1 | A1 IH1 A2 IH2 ]; intros K HA HXY.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl.
    + apply notin_singleton. intro H; apply HXY; symmetry; auto.
    + apply notin_empty_1.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. exact HA.
  - simpl in HA. simpl. apply IH1; auto.
  - simpl in HA.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    simpl. apply notin_union.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fv_open_tt : forall X Y A,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X <> Y ->
  X \notin fv_tt (open_tt A Y).
Proof. intros. apply fv_open_tt_rec with (K := 0); auto. Qed.

Lemma posvar_flip_notin : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar (flip_im m) X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H.
  induction H as
    [ X m
    | X A m Hty
    | X A m Hty
    | X
    | X Y m HXY
    | X m A1 A2 B1 B2 Hp1 IH1 Hp2 IH2
    | X m A B L H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | A X m L HX H1 IH1 ];
    intros HA HB.
  - apply pos_nat.
  - apply pos_top. auto.
  - apply pos_top_flip. auto.
  - simpl in HA. exfalso. apply HA. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
  - apply pos_fvar_y. auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HA) as HA2.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB1.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (fv_tt B1) (fv_tt B2) HB) as HB2.
    apply pos_arrow.
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + apply IH2; auto.
  - simpl in HA. simpl in HB.
    assert (HXY : forall Y, Y \notin L \u {{X}} -> X <> Y).
    { intros Y HY. apply (notin_singleton_1 X Y).
      apply (notin_union_2 Y L (singleton X)). exact HY. }
    apply pos_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY. apply IH1.
      * exact HY.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
      * apply fv_open_tt_rec; auto.
    + intros Y HY. apply H2. exact HY.
  - apply pos_rec_t with (L := L); auto.
Qed.

Lemma posvar_to_Pos : forall m X A B,
  posvar m X A B ->
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  posvar Pos X A B.
Proof.
  intros m X A B H HA HB. destruct m.
  - simpl. apply posvar_flip_notin with (m := Neg); auto.
  - exact H.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* The soundness invariant                                      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Definition K (im : IsoMode) (evs : atoms) (E : Rules.env) (A B : typ) : Prop :=
  (forall X, X \notin evs -> X \notin dom E -> posvar im X A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub im) E -> Z \notin evs -> posvar Pos Z A B)
  /\ (forall Z, binds Z (Rules.bind_sub (flip_im im)) E -> Z \notin evs
                -> posvar Neg Z A B).

Lemma compose_cm_Eq : forall cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2,
  compose_cm cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 = Some Eq -> cm1 = Eq /\ cm2 = Eq.
Proof.
  intros cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 H. destruct cm1, cm2; simpl in *; try discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs2); discriminate.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.is_empty evs1); discriminate.
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma open_tt_injA : forall X A B,
  X \notin fv_tt A -> X \notin fv_tt B ->
  open_tt A X = open_tt B X -> A = B.
Proof. intros. eapply open_tt_rec_inj; eauto. Qed.

Lemma Sub_eq_implies_eq : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> cm = Eq -> A = B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ];
    intros Hcm; try discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite Hcm in Hcomp. apply compose_cm_Eq in Hcomp. destruct Hcomp as [E1 E2].
    f_equal.
    + symmetry. apply IH1. exact E1.
    + apply IH2. exact E2.
  - (* rec_eq_notin *)
    destruct (atom_fresh ((L \u fv_tt A1) \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXa.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXb.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HXL.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HX1.
    assert (Hop : open_tt A1 X = open_tt A2 X) by (apply IHf; auto).
    f_equal. eapply open_tt_inj; eauto.
  - (* rec_eq_in *)
    destruct (atom_fresh ((L \u fv_tt A1) \u fv_tt A2)) as [X HX].
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXa.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X (L \u fv_tt A1) (fv_tt A2) HX) as HXb.
    pose proof (notin_union_1 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HXL.
    pose proof (notin_union_2 X L (fv_tt A1) HXa) as HX1.
    assert (Hop : open_tt A1 X = open_tt A2 X) by (apply IHf; auto).
    f_equal. eapply open_tt_inj; eauto.
  - auto.
Qed.

  - apply type_mu with (L := L). intros X HX.

  - apply type_mu with (L := L). intros X HX.
    destruct (IHf X HX) as [_ [_ [T2 _]]]. exact T2.

    + intros X HX.

      * unfold K in HK. apply (proj1 HK). exact HXe. exact HXd.
      * exact HXf1.
      * exact HXf2.

Qed.

Lemma notin5 : forall (x:atom) (A B C D E : atoms),
  x \notin (((A \u B) \u C) \u D) \u E ->
  x \notin A /\ x \notin B /\ x \notin C /\ x \notin D /\ x \notin E.
Proof.
  intros x A B C D E H.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export LinearRule.

Inductive binding : Set :=
  | bind_sub : binding
  | bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Inductive WFS : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WFS_top : forall E, WFS E typ_top
| WFS_nat : forall E, WFS E typ_nat
| WFS_fvar : forall X E ,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    WFS E (typ_fvar X)
| WFS_arrow : forall E A B,
    WFS E A ->
    WFS E B ->
    WFS E (typ_arrow A B)
| WFS_rec : forall L E A,


      (forall  X , X \notin L ->
        WFS (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      WFS E (typ_mu A).

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) ,
      wf_env E ->
      X \notin dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WFS E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub_amber2: env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sam2_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E typ_nat typ_nat
| sam2_top: forall E A,
    WFS E A ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E A typ_top
| sam2_fvar: forall E X,
    binds X (bind_sub) E ->
    wf_env E ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sam2_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub_amber2 E B1 A1 ->
    sub_amber2 E A2 B2 ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sam2_rec: forall E A B L,
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                sub_amber2 (X ~ bind_sub ++ E) (open_tt A X) (open_tt B X)) ->
    (forall X , X \notin L ->
                posvar Pos X (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)) ->
    sub_amber2 E (typ_mu A) (typ_mu B)
.

Definition drop_im b :=
  match b with
  | Rules.bind_sub _ => bind_sub
  | Rules.bind_typ t => bind_typ t
  end.

Definition drop_im_env := map drop_im.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Basic facts about modes and environments                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma flip_im_invol : forall im, flip_im (flip_im im) = im.
Proof. destruct im; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma flip_im_neq : forall im, im <> flip_im im.
Proof. destruct im; discriminate. Qed.

Lemma drop_im_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  drop_im_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ drop_im b ++ drop_im_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold drop_im_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma dom_drop_im_env : forall E, dom (drop_im_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold drop_im_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_drop_im : forall (X:atom) (b:Rules.binding) (E:Rules.env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (drop_im b) (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold drop_im_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

(* environment lift from Task bindings to Rules bindings, all bind_sub Pos *)
Definition epos_bind (b : binding) : Rules.binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub => Rules.bind_sub Pos
  | bind_typ t => Rules.bind_typ t
  end.

Definition epos_env : env -> Rules.env := map epos_bind.

Lemma epos_env_cons : forall (x:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ b ++ E) = x ~ epos_bind b ++ epos_env E.
Proof. intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma epos_env_cons_sub : forall (x:atom) (E:env),
  epos_env (x ~ bind_sub ++ E) = x ~ Rules.bind_sub Pos ++ epos_env E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. simpl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma dom_epos_env : forall E, dom (epos_env E) = dom E.
Proof.
  intros E. unfold epos_env. induction E as [| (x,b) E IH]; simpl; auto.
  rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos : forall (X:atom) (b:binding) (E:env),
  binds X b E -> binds X (epos_bind b) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. unfold epos_env. eapply binds_map_2. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_epos_sub : forall (X:atom) (E:env),
  binds X bind_sub E -> binds X (Rules.bind_sub Pos) (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros. change (binds X (epos_bind bind_sub) (epos_env E)).
  apply binds_epos. auto.
Qed.

(* wf_env is unique *)
Lemma wf_env_uniq : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - constructor.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
  - simpl. constructor; auto.
Qed.

(* rules WFS -> type *)
Lemma Rules_WFS_type : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> type A.
Proof.
  intros E A H. induction H.
  - apply type_top.
  - apply type_nat.
  - apply type_var.
  - apply type_arrow; auto.
  - apply type_mu with (L := L). auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* WFS and wf_env transport                                     *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Rules_WFS_drop : forall E A, Rules.WFS E A -> WFS (drop_im_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E im Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A im Hf IHf].
  - apply WFS_top.
  - apply WFS_nat.
  - apply WFS_fvar. eapply binds_drop_im with (b := Rules.bind_sub im). auto.
  - apply WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply WFS_rec with (L := L). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite drop_im_env_cons in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Task_WFS_epos : forall E A, WFS E A -> Rules.WFS (epos_env E) A.
Proof.
  intros E A H.
  induction H as [E | E | X E Hb | E A B HW1 IH1 HW2 IH2
                  | L E A Hf IHf].
  - apply Rules.WFS_top.
  - apply Rules.WFS_nat.
  - eapply Rules.WFS_fvar. apply binds_epos_sub. auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_arrow; auto.
  - apply Rules.WFS_rec with (L := L) (im := Pos). intros X HX.
    specialize (IHf X HX). rewrite epos_env_cons_sub in IHf. exact IHf.
Qed.

Lemma Rules_wf_env_drop : forall E, Rules.wf_env E -> wf_env (drop_im_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
  - rewrite drop_im_env_cons. apply wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Rules_WFS_drop. auto.
    * rewrite dom_drop_im_env. auto.
Qed.

Lemma Task_wf_env_epos : forall E, wf_env E -> Rules.wf_env (epos_env E).
Proof.
  intros E H. induction H.
  - simpl. apply Rules.wf_env_empty.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons_sub. apply Rules.wf_env_sub; auto.
    rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
  - rewrite epos_env_cons. apply Rules.wf_env_typ; auto.
    * apply Task_WFS_epos. auto.
    * rewrite dom_epos_env. auto.
Qed.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Sub derives well-typed endpoints, and Eq derivations relate  *)
(* syntactically equal types.                                   *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma Sub_type : forall im cm evs E A B,
  Rules.Sub im cm evs E A B -> type A /\ type B.
Proof.
  intros im cm evs E A B H.
  induction H as
    [ E im Hwf
    | E im Hwf
    | E im A Hwf HWFS Hne
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E X im Hwf Hb
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 cm1 cm2 evs1 evs2 cm im H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hcomp
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | L A1 A2 evs E im Hf IHf
    | im cm evs evs' E A1 A2 H1 IH1 Heq ].
  - split; apply type_nat.
  - split; apply type_top.
